author: Paula Ricardo
title: Somewhat Positive News Coverage Somewhat Unlikely to Affect Tableau Software (DATA) Share Price
text:
Notable Thursday Option Activity: NFLX, AAPL, DATA (nasdaq.com) 
A number of analysts recently weighed in on DATA shares. KeyCorp reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $85.00 price target on shares of Tableau Software in a research report on Friday, October 6th. Barclays reissued a “buy” rating and set a $80.00 target price on shares of Tableau Software in a research note on Wednesday, October 11th. Needham & Company LLC assumed coverage on Tableau Software in a research note on Monday, October 23rd. They set a “buy” rating and a $98.00 target price for the company. Bank of America increased their target price on Tableau Software from $84.00 to $90.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, October 18th. Finally, BidaskClub cut Tableau Software from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, November 7th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, fourteen have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $72.41. 
Shares of Tableau Software ( DATA ) traded up $0.33 on Monday, hitting $77.15. 854,537 shares of the stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 622,163. The company has a market cap of $6,150.00, a PE ratio of -36.56 and a beta of 0.82. Tableau Software has a one year low of $46.76 and a one year high of $82.32. 
Tableau Software (NYSE:DATA) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The software company reported $0.08 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $0.01 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $214.90 million during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $219.43 million. Tableau Software had a negative net margin of 18.76% and a negative return on equity of 20.89%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 4.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period last year, the business earned $0.16 EPS. analysts anticipate that Tableau Software will post -1.64 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
In related news, CEO Adam Selipsky sold 1,600 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Tuesday, December 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $68.45, for a total value of $109,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the chief executive officer now directly owns 229,828 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $15,731,726.60. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this link . Also, insider Christian Chabot sold 450,000 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Wednesday, November 8th. The shares were sold at an average price of $70.49, for a total transaction of $31,720,500.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 231,820 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $16,340,991.80. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 692,286 shares of company stock valued at $48,819,636 over the last ninety days. Company insiders own 24.76% of the company’s stock.
